isolated_execution.hashes: Hash source snapshot, adapter, generated original/modified scripts, binary, engine/catalog sources, map, accessibility, design and runtime versions before run. time_budget_interpretation: The previous same-seed22GiB run was OOM-killed after1774.56seconds (~29.6min). Failure to finish remains censored/incomplete feasibility evidence; no timeout extension, memory escalation or another case is implied.
reporting: Preserve original OOM and all attempt denominators; record new completion/OOM/timeout independently with phase/progress logs. Do not inspect localization accuracy to decide retries or settings. No full48panel expansion.
